name: Never In The Same Place
body:
School conjuration (teleportation); Level: jester 6

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 immediate action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You teleport 50 feet to an empty square within sight. In addition, until the end of your next turn, you may teleport any creature that ends its turn adjacent to you 15 feet as an immediate action.
